## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmations: (1) cross-sector breadth slightly positive but mixed week/week1 signals across megacaps, (2) major divergence among large caps (AAPL RECOVERY, NVDA CORRECTION, JPM CORRECTION) supporting indecision.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Staples lead: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.50% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +4.41%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak and Industrials lag: CAT (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -8.74%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -10.26% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION. Technology soft this week: ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.50% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +24.83%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -9.79% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION, AMD (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -12.49%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.45% | 1M: -9.61%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology/semis.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.50% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among big caps (AAPL, NVDA, JPM) suggesting this is tactical momentum, not unanimous market follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed with short-term weakness: INTU (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +24.83%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +8.75% | 1M: +22.73%) ABOVE TREND versus INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION; sector showing Internal Rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed/rotational: V (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.69% | 1M: +11.16%) ABOVE TREND while JPM (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION — overall internal rotation, not a clean cyclical bid.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare constructive: MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY — sector showing consistent breadth and leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Consumer Staples, Materials and selective Healthcare where leaders are ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging Technology semis and weak Industrials. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective given major divergence in large caps.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -8.74%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Consumer Staples (1W: +5.67%), Healthcare (1W: +3.97%), Materials (1W: +1.54%) — breadth constructive. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.56%) and Industrials (1W: -2.39%) — watch for further dispersion among megacaps.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION — failure to reclaim the short-term pivot would signal further tech pressure. AAPL (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -6.73%) RECOVERY — sustain 1W gains to confirm reversal. FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND — continued follow-through would extend materials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (+60): BA (1W: -6.86% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION — bullish contract headline but price in short-term pullback (divergence). LRCX (+55): LRCX (1W: -9.79% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION — analyst optimism while stock is in short-term pullback (watch for follow-through). AMD (+55): AMD (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -12.49%) BELOW TREND — upgrade-driven headlines are diverging from price, tactical only.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ASML (-45): ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND — negative press confirming price weakness. WMT (-45): WMT (1W: -6.63% | 1M: -2.49%) BELOW TREND — sales miss aligns with downside momentum.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; style mixed / no clear leadership. EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND and MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps—AAPL (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -6.73%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION and JPM (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION—watch for confirmed trend break or follow-through.
